jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist - Paid Social (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Was Du Bei Uns Machen Wirst

Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen?

Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Als Senior Creative Strategist bei Zasta bringst du Menschen, die beim Wort „Steuererklärung“ sofort weiterscrollen, dazu, anzuhalten, die App zu laden und loszulegen. Wie? Mit Ads auf TikTok und Instagram, die mutig, lustig und auch mal provokant sind.

Das Beste daran:
Wir bauen gerade unsere Inhouse Agency auf und du gestaltest sie von Grund auf mit – von Prozessen über Formate bis zur Arbeitsweise.

Du bekommst viel kreativen Freiraum, entwickelst neue Creative Angles, testest, was wirklich funktioniert, und bringst große Ideen auch mal ins TV.

Du arbeitest bereits eigenständig in der Creative Strategy und bist bereit für den nächsten Schritt auf Senior-Level? Dann bist du bei uns genauso richtig wie jemand, der den Senior-Titel bereits trägt.

Deine Aufgaben

Paid Social ist dein Zuhause: Rund 80 % deiner Zeit drehen sich um Ads auf TikTok und Instagram. Du entwickelst laufend neue Ideen, Hooks und Formate und bringst sie schnell live.
Zielgruppe verstehen: Du weißt, was unsere Zielgruppe scrollt, teilt und kommentiert. Du erkennst Trends früh und machst daraus Creatives, die sich nicht wie Werbung anfühlen.
Ideen in Serie: Du machst auch langweilige Themen interessant. Steuer sind nicht unbedingt ein Scroll-Stopper. Deine Ads schon!"
Daten, Tests, Learnings: Du schaust täglich, was performt. Du testest Varianten gegeneinander und lässt jedes Learning direkt ins nächste Konzept fließen.
Eng im Team: Du bist die Brücke zwischen Performance Marketing, Data und Agenturen, also zwischen „Was sagen die Daten?“ und „Was machen wir jetzt Geiles daraus?“.
Produktion: Du begleitest dein kleines Creative Team bei der Produktion deiner Konzepte von Anfang bis Ende mit, bist bei Drehs dabei und führst Regie. Mit deinem Feedback zu den fertigen Assets stellst du sicher, dass Konzept, Tonalität und Umsetzung stimmen.
Und manchmal: TV. Auch das Fernsehen ist für uns ein wichtiger Kanal. Du entwickelst kreative Konzepte, mit denen wir neue Zielgruppen erschließen und unsere bestehenden Zielgruppen weiter ausbauen.

Was Du Idealerweise Mitbringst

Creative Strategy: Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, Concepting oder Kampagnenentwicklung – idealerweise im digitalen Performance-Umfeld.
Paid Social: Du kennst TikTok und Instagram, hast bereits erfolgreiche Paid-Social-Creatives entwickelt und kannst uns deine Arbeit anhand eines Portfolios zeigen.
Performance-Verständnis: Du kennst den Meta und TikTok Ads Manager und weißt, wie du Daten, Insights und Zielgruppenpsychologie in kreative Ideen übersetzt, die Leads bringen.
Social-First-Mindset: Du bist immer auf dem neuesten Stand der Social-Trends, denkst in Umsetzung statt in Slides und probierst lieber heute drei Ideen aus, als nächsten Monat eine perfekte zu präsentieren.
Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau und bist sicher im Umgang mit englischen Marketing-Begriffen.

Nice to have:
Du bringst bereits Erfahrung mit TV-Kampagnen mit. Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Was Wir Dir Bieten

Gesundes Wachstum & Stabilität: Wir sind profitabel und wachsen nachhaltig aus eigener Stärke – für langfristige Perspektiven und ambitionierte Ziele.
Nah dran statt weit weg: Bei uns arbeiten Teams und Management eng zusammen – mit kurzen Wegen, direktem Austausch und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe.
Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
Flexibles hybrides Arbeiten: Wir treffen uns an zwei Tagen pro Woche im Büro – dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock, mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die übrigen Tage gestaltest du flexibel. Für Ausnahmen an Präsenztagen gibt es unsere Jokertage.
Ein Gehalt, das deiner Erfahrung gerecht wird. Wir bieten dir ein attraktives Gehalt, das zu deiner Erfahrung und der Verantwortung der Rolle passt.
30 Tage Urlaub: Damit neben ambitionierten Zielen auch genügend Zeit zum Abschalten bleibt.
Workation in Europa: Du möchtest zwischendurch den Arbeitsplatz wechseln? Bei Zasta kannst du bis zu vier Wochen am Stück innerhalb der EU arbeiten.

Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben.

Dein Kontakt Bei Zasta

Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über jobs@zasta.de schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet
. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!

Über uns

Zasta wurde 2017 gegründet und ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App-Stores. Unsere Software ermöglicht es jedem Steuerzahler ohne großen Aufwand eine professionelle Steuererklärung einzureichen. Unsere Plattform arbeitet mit echten Steuerberatern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder das beste Ergebnis erhält - auch ohne Steuerwissen. Über 2 Millionen Nutzer vertrauen bereits in unsere App. Komm auch du mit auf unsere Reise, ein nerviges Finanzthema in einen freudigen Geldregen zu verwandeln.

jobs.title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - Design Studios
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Senior Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.

You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.

You contribute to the studio’s creative and technical exploration. You proactively explore, test, and develop working knowledge of emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover with the team around you. You are developing a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.

You also work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior team members. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You contribute to workshops, help shape narratives, and support organisations in understanding not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.

Day To Day, You Will

Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualisation, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
Contribute to building capability across the studio. You participate in workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

YOU’RE GOOD AT

Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call
Moving between creative and technical contexts without losing the thread of either. You think like a maker in both rooms
Explaining what is technically possible in a way that gets non-technical people genuinely interested, not just nodding along
Balancing experimentation with delivery, knowing when to push and when to ship

What You'll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field
4 to 6 years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment
Fluency in Python, JavaScript, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution
Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, ComfyUI, or similar, applied in a creative context
Experience building agentic systems and pipelines: prompt taxonomies, evaluation rubrics, multi-step workflows, API orchestration. You understand RAG, tool use, and context windows at a working level
Experience with automation frameworks, systems integration, and the judgment to know when to build versus when to connect
An understanding of how brands work and how digital moments can create something people remember
Growing confidence presenting to and working with clients, and developing ability to contribute to sessions, help shape a narrative, and support a review

Who You'll Work With

As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most cutting-edge design solutions.

Additional info

We are Design Studios, an in-house creative agency comprised of cutting-edge professionals creating premium designs. We are a global, multidisciplinary team of design strategists, creative leaders, and digital experts. We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges. As part of BCG, Design Studios partners with consultants and clients to shape our brand by elevating our work through the power of design. We offer guidance and orientation through a strategic and audience-centric approach, and apply design, technology, and media solutions to take BCG’s achievements to the next level.

As bold design leaders, we are fresh, punchy, and playful, while committed to delivering premium business excellence. We recognize how to transform complex ideas into compelling visual experiences, and how to activate new commercial opportunities at the intersection of business and design. We value innovation, co-creation, inspiration, and the business impact that design achieves. We believe in the art of the possible and in applying creative solutions to business challenges. We believe we can advance the world by conquering its complexity through a universal human language—design.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

jobs.title: AI Motion Designer & Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
Budapest

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

Job Purpose

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service, working with our UK teams from Hungary. We combine data, technology, creative and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like social, influencer, TTL ad campaigns, augmented reality, AI and innovation. Our clients include eBay, easyJet, Open Ai and Google.

We are looking for an AI Designer & Creative Technologist to join our creative team. The role has two halves: delivering AI-led creative work on live client projects, and building the tools and workflows that make the wider agency faster at it. The client work is varied, from fast-turnaround BAU creative responses to in-person creative sprints and full campaign productions across global markets, and generative AI now runs through most of it.

On the delivery side, you will take briefs from early thinking through to finished, client-ready work using generative image, video and audio tools alongside the Adobe suite, working with designers, motion designers, art directors and producers to make AI output on brand, consistent, and following legal specifications. On the technology side, you will spot the repetitive, manual parts of how our designers work and build things that remove them: automation pipelines, scripts, plugins and small internal tools.

This is a hands-on role and we are open to all levels of experience: what matters is the quality of your work and your judgement about when and how to use these tools. The scope of the role, from how much you lead to how much you guide others, will be shaped around the experience you bring. You will work day to day with creative directors, account teams and clients in the UK, mostly remotely, and contribute to creative sprints and workshops, in person where possible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Turn creative briefs into AI-generated and AI-enhanced imagery, video and motion across social, paid, digital and campaign work
Build and refine prompts and workflows across image and video generation tools, keeping a library of what works per client
Finish AI output in Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere Pro so it sits seamlessly alongside photography, design and live action
Keep brand and character consistency across generated assets using references, style guides and custom models
Produce rapid concepts, styleframes and visual explorations to help teams pitch and iterate faster
Build repeatable AI workflows, prompt frameworks and best-practice documentation for the team
Spot repetitive, manual steps in how designers work and build tools that remove them: Adobe and Figma scripts and plugins, node-based pipelines, small browser utilities
Prototype and maintain internal tools with the people who use them, iterating on real feedback
Be a point of knowledge on AI for creative directors and account teams: what’s possible, what it costs in time and risk, how to pitch it
Own responsible use of AI on your work: client tool guidelines, data handling, IP and likeness, disclosure labelling and provenance metadata
Work with producers to scope AI-led deliverables accurately, flagging where AI isn’t the right route
Share what you build and learn through show-and-tells and training sessions
Present work internally and externally to an excellent standard
Stay close to new tools and models, testing them against real briefs and recommending what we adopt

WHAT YOU BRING:

A portfolio of AI-generated or AI-enhanced work finished to a professional standard, for brands, agencies or personal projects
Solid design fundamentals: composition, typography, colour and an eye for what looks right on screen
Hands-on experience building work in node-based AI workflows (e.g. Figma Weave, ComfyUI, Flora) that chain models like Flux, Veo, Kling and Sora with editing steps, and the judgement to pick the right model and route for the job
Strong Photoshop skills, with working After Effects and/or Premiere Pro to take output through to finish
Some ability to build as well as make: scripting or automation (e.g. Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript, Figma plugins, ComfyUI) used to speed up creative work
A problem-solver’s instinct for spotting inefficiency in a workflow and fixing it properly
Understanding of how social, paid and digital assets are specced and delivered (formats, safe zones, aspect ratios, versioning)
Awareness of the ethical, legal and brand-safety considerations around generative AI in commercial work
Fluent English, with confidence explaining your process and presenting to creative directors, account teams and clients
A willingness to share what you know and help others get better with these tools
Curious, experimental and self-directed when a tool or workflow doesn’t exist yet
Nice to have: motion, 3D or VFX background, custom model training, LLM APIs and agentic tooling, content provenance standards.

WE OFFER

Private health insurance and access to a range of healthcare and preventive services.
Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.
Dog-friendly office
Hybrid working policy
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.
Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

jobs.title: Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport.
That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

About The Role

LemFi moves money home for people who live between countries. Behind every transfer there is a real story: school fees, a wedding, a mother's new roof. We have the mission, the communities and the brand platform. What we need now is someone who can find those stories, write them, and make them look unmissable.

You will report to the VP of Brand and Design, and sit at the centre of a lean creative team. You will concept campaigns alongside Isabel, write the words, set the visual direction, and lead the activations that make LemFi feel like it genuinely belongs to the communities it serves. This is not a brief-taking role. You will bring 10 ideas, kill 8, sharpen 2, and then make the 2 real.

What you'll build and own

Find the stories: dig into our customers, corridors and cultures, and turn real lives into campaign ideas that land across markets
Write the work: manifestos, scripts, headlines, social, OOH and launch narratives, copy that is sharp enough to stand alone
Set the visual direction: art-direct campaigns, shoots and brand films so the idea is as strong visually as it is in words
Lead activations: concept and run real-world moments, events, partnerships and cultural drops across our markets, from idea to on-the-ground execution
Brief and direct: brief designers, directors, agencies and creators, push the work until it earns its place
Build the brand platform: grow the creative system so it scales consistently across channels and corridors, using AI tools to move through concept rounds faster
Measure what lands: track reach, engagement and brand lift, iterate fast and feed what you learn back into the work

Your experience

4 or more years at a top creative agency as a copywriter, art director or creative, you know what world-class craft actually takes
2 or more years building or relaunching a brand at a startup or scale-up, shipping with small teams and tight budgets
Portfolio that shows at least 1 strong agency campaign and 1 brand you built or rebuilt in-house, with your specific role on each made clear
Copy and art direction: one is your home craft, the other is genuinely strong, not borrowed from someone else on the brief
Activations shipped: you have taken ideas off the screen into events, partnerships or cultural moments that actually reached people
Real-people storytelling: you have made work from human truths, documentary, testimonials, community voices
Cultural fluency: you understand the communities LemFi serves across its corridors, or you are obsessive about learning them

Nice to have

Fintech, remittance or regulated-category experience, including financial promotions
Rebrand experience end to end: strategy, identity and launch
Directing or writing shoots and brand films, or long-form editorial work

Why join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.

Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

Recruitment agencies notice

Experience in healthcare, telehealth, pharma or another regulated advertising environment

jobs.description:
Most supplements ask you to live around them: same pill, same powder, every morning, whether your body needs it or not.

At noew, we flipped that. Life isn’t a routine. It’s the early run, the deadline, the short night and the night out, sometimes all in the same week. We build for those moments. Our formulas meet your body when its need actually goes up, and our app reads your data so you know what you need before you even ask.

We just went live, out of Amsterdam, with Europe as our first market. A small team, a real product and a scientific board behind every formula. What we need now is the person who decides how all of it looks and feels.

One role, three titles

The work is the same: make noew look and feel like nothing else out there. Where you start depends on what you’ve done:
Allround creative: you’re a strong maker with a sharp eye
Art director: you’ve set the visual direction for a brand and led shoots
Creative director: you’ve built a brand’s creative from scratch and led a team

We level you on what you’ve done. You grow on what you build here.

What you’ll do

Set and guard noew’s art direction everywhere people meet us: social, ads, the app, the site and packaging
Turn the brand into a system others can build on: visual language, photo and video direction, templates
Concept and direct campaigns and shoots, from moodboard to final edit, and make a lot of it with your own hands
Brief and direct our graphic designers and creators, and keep raising the bar
Work side by side with our Head of Growth: you bring the ideas, growth tests them at volume, and together you learn what actually moves people
Own how our channels look and feel: Instagram and TikTok first, then LinkedIn and whatever platform earns its place

What success looks like

Six months in, people recognise a noew post in half a second, with the logo covered. Designers and creators can work from your direction without you in the room. And we know from data, not gut feeling, which ideas work and why.

Who you are

Your portfolio shows taste and range, and you can explain the thinking behind every piece
You make things yourself: design, shoot, edit. Figma, Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, whatever gets it done
You direct others well: clear briefs, honest feedback, a high bar without slowing everything down
You think in systems, not single pieces: one look that works in a six-second ad, on a pouch and on an app screen
You move fast and would rather test ten ideas this month than polish one
Fluent in English
Bonus: experience in DTC, wellness, sport, fashion, music or nightlife; motion design or photography

What you get

The chance to shape a brand while it’s brand new: what you make in your first year becomes the brand
Ownership: a stake in noew through our ESOP, plus a salary that matches your level
Room to grow into leading the creative team as we scale
A small team with short lines: you work directly with the founders
A product with real science behind it, so you never have to sell something you don’t believe in
Hybrid, from our office in Amsterdam

How to apply

Send three things to jobs@noew.co:
Your portfolio
One line on the work you’re proudest of, and why it worked
The last thing that made you stop scrolling, and what got you

No cover letter needed. If there’s a fit, we’ll meet first and then do a paid trial together.
Whoever you are, you’re welcome here. We hire on talent and taste.

jobs.location: Ajman, Ajman Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

This isn’t another content job.
Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our Creative Machine Has To Be Able To

Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.
Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.
Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.
Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.
Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.
Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

OUR MISSION

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We Do That By Merging

Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

Short history

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy
Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.
Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery
Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
Deliver what you pitch.
❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.
Build the Content Factory: humans and agents
Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar.
Fuel the Growth Engine
Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works.
❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything.
🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human.
Go global, and keep the soul
We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated.
And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

How you’ll know you’re AI-native:
you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t.

THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍

Experience

Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers.
Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes.
Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics.
AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate.

Traits :

Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces.
Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them.
A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed.
Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it.
No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy.

Language

French: Native / Bilingual

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place.

❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season.

❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place.

❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role.

❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make.

❌ If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount.

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

You’ll compete with San Francisco companies.

Growth & Ambition

> 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Competitive Salary

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

Impact & Meaning

> Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people
> Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!

We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

> 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability
> 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working)
> 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want
> 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices
> 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :)
> 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)
> 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that
> 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

How To Apply 📃

⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀

HIRING PROCESS 📃

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI

💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team

💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build

💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

🫵🚀 Welcome

Amazon’s Brand Innovation Lab is looking for a talented, passionate, and a hands-on Creative (Art Director) to conceptualise and create one-of-a-kind campaigns for a wide range of brands across MENA. From ideation through launch, you will be responsible for delivering ambitious, insightful, and data-driven concepts that translate needs and constraints into customer-focused brand campaign ideas and solutions. This could include video content, user interface designs for voice and screen, interaction models, prototypes, and interactive advertising campaigns. This role will use data and insights to create campaign strategy and concepts, develop designs and the look and feel for experiences, as well as templates for never-before-done brand campaigns and experiences that will solve customer problems, on and off Amazon platforms.

Candidates should have an in-depth understanding of AI tools, Photoshop, Illustrator, PowerPoint, Figma and Webflow, (or an interest to learn Webflow), and understanding of UX design.

The candidate’s portfolio should feature highly creative, award-winning campaigns and ideas that solve customer and advertiser problems through a variety of different media channels, including but not limited to video, social, digital activations, and outdoor. You have strong conceptual, presentation, storytelling, and time management skills, as well as digital media experience, insight-driven and strategic thinking, and of course, an acute attention to detail.

Key job responsibilities

Concept, design (art), and execute innovative ad campaigns and experiences for global brands.

Partner with designers, program managers, developers, strategists, business leads, and producers to create customer-focused solutions that deliver on advertiser objectives.

Independently lead campaigns from brief to execution and collaborate with internal teams, clients, and external agency partners.
Obsessed with understanding customers and making work that delivers both innovation and results.
Present ideas and concepts to clients, agencies, and internally.
Proven ability to ideate for film, print, digital, out-of-home, experiential, and social.
Ability to manage multiple projects at once within budget and deadlines.
Be proactive in developing new products and ideas on behalf of the customer.

A day in the life

Partnering with a variety of brands, media, and creative agencies to work on innovative campaigns for travel and tourism, automotive, finance, consumables, telecommunication etc.
From designing brand experiences (digital and physical), from documentary films in Prime Video to Alexa branded experiences, you will always strive to create never-before-done ideas.
Presenting a campaign to senior brand clients and their partners in creative and media agencies.
Reviewing edits and work in progress with your partners, collecting and responding to feedback in order to meet the highest creative standards.
Work with your team on proactive projects and initiatives and bring them to life.

About The Team

The Brand Innovation Lab is Amazon' Ads Innovation team dedicated to creating one-of-a-kind campaigns and activations for global advertisers.

Leveraging the full Amazon canvas: custom landing pages, Alexa, Fire TV, Twitch, Prime Video, and more. We build campaigns that reach millions of customers across digital channels and in the real world.

The team also works on Prime Video IP and brands, developing co-branded full-funnel campaigns.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in driving compelling creative strategy and execution at an agency or in-house creative team
Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates
In-depth understanding of industry design tools (Ex. Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma), and a basic understanding of UX design and UX design Tools (ie. Webflow)

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Keynote
Experience developing cross-functional relationships with product, consumer research and marketing teams to develop strategy and consumer insights that drive compelling creative executions
Experience leading creative development of innovative creative from concept to delivery
Experience presenting creative concepts effectively to senior executives
Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines
Experience in developing creative concepts and executing campaigns for brand partnerships and/or sponsorships

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

You are a creative coder, an inventor, and a technical artist. You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Senior Creative (Hybrid) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. Code is your primary craft.

You build the prototypes, experiences, and tools that bring our most imaginative concepts to life. You move fluidly from fast, AI-assisted “vibe-coding” for quick conceptual sketches to production-ready frameworks like React and Next.js when structure matters. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture.

You contribute to the studio’s creative and technical exploration. You proactively explore, test, and develop working knowledge of emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover with the team around you. You are developing a sharp instinct for where technology makes the work better and where it gets in the way. That instinct is what makes you genuinely useful, not just technically capable.

You also work alongside clients and BCG case teams, supported by senior team members. You translate technical possibilities into ideas people get excited about. You contribute to workshops, help shape narratives, and support organisations in understanding not just what AI can do but how to make it work inside their actual creative process.

Day To Day, You Will

Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. You know the difference between a tool and a pipeline and you build the latter
Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works
Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft
Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualisation, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it
Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case
Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands
Contribute to building capability across the studio. You participate in workshops, share discoveries, and help designers, producers, and consultants understand what is possible and how to use it well
Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. You make the technical feel accessible without making it feel smaller

Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over
Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for
Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, ComfyUI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time
Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever
Knowing when to prompt-engineer, when to fine-tune, and when to build a deterministic step. You understand the trade-offs and you make the call
Moving between creative and technical contexts without losing the thread of either. You think like a maker in both rooms
Explaining what is technically possible in a way that gets non-technical people genuinely interested, not just nodding along
Balancing experimentation with delivery, knowing when to push and when to ship

What You'll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field
4 to 6 years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment
Fluency in Python, JavaScript, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution
Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, ComfyUI, or similar, applied in a creative context
Experience building agentic systems and pipelines: prompt taxonomies, evaluation rubrics, multi-step workflows, API orchestration. You understand RAG, tool use, and context windows at a working level
Experience with automation frameworks, systems integration, and the judgment to know when to build versus when to connect
An understanding of how brands work and how digital moments can create something people remember
Growing confidence presenting to and working with clients, and developing ability to contribute to sessions, help shape a narrative, and support a review

As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. GDS comprises a diverse group of talented design professionals across video, content, digital design, and more—all working collaboratively to deliver the most cutting-edge design solutions.

We craft powerful design stories for BCG to deliver inspiring solutions to our clients’ challenges.
